capabilities: Rename tags and their child tags across the vault
Merge tags into existing tags with a confirmation warning
Create and open tag pages linked by tag aliases
Add tags to or exclude tags from the current search
Collapse and expand tag hierarchies in the tags view
extras: The README warns that renames are irreversible, especially merges into existing tags, and recommends backing up the vault first; it also documents workspace events other plugins can hook into. Tag renaming does not work in Canvas files. Requires the core Tags View plugin to be enabled.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds a context menu to the pane provided by that plugin, and does not have any UI of its own.
problem: Obsidian's tags view only lets you click a tag to search for it, with no way to rename, merge, reorganize, or act on tags from the view.

relations.evidence: Open a random note with that tag (if you have the Smart Random Note plugin installed and enabled)
For users of Quickadd and other plugins that allow user-defined Javascript

summary: Tag management tool that adds a context menu to the tags view for renaming, merging, and searching tags, plus creating tag pages.
